source.instrument: Capstone 5.0.7 x86 32-bit disassembly over a read-only PE32 section mapping; ghidra CLI xrefs as leads

scope: Consumer of the 0x78-byte Sqwt command-parameter record: the form-level Executed handler, the kind-to-variant switch, the Lua entry points and the subscription gate. Command semantics of individual UILuaCommands are Lua behavior and are not established here.

thunkArguments.scriptObject: form +0x80 holds a pointer to a holder, the thunk loads it before the vtable
thunkArguments.subscription: map value from 0x00535b70, the command string with +0x54 and +0x55

entryGates: 0x005362cc: call 0x0091a1b0 then 0x00919d30, return when the boolean is 1
0x005362de, 0x005362e9: return when args+4 or args+8 is null
0x00536535: return when form element +0x100 is zero
0x00536601..0x00536659: the six generic UILuaCommands share one per-frame flag at +0x1ec

registration.plainTemplateKey: form root name at +0x164, passed at 0x0053abf7

subscriptionGate.controlNameRule: control name equal to the form root name is replaced by _widget at 0x005365b1
subscriptionGate.templateNameRule: template name equal to the form root name selects the variant that passes an empty first string (0x005365e2..0x005365f7)

scriptInterface.requestDepthLimit: 0x00896d33: reject when the nesting count at +0x14 is 8 or more

parameterObjects.pushOrder: string0 (nil when empty), string1, string2, then the variant values

unknowns: The release point of the first stored event at queue +4 and the caller cadence of 0x00896ed0.
The role of the gate object at form element +0x27c that sees the record before the subscription lookup.
The Button, KeyBinding and PadBinding command invocation sites that put a record into an Executed event.

BLOCKING: how an event with the Executed id 0x2a reaches the handler when the subscription call adds it for the unnamed event at 0x01336a84 (id 0x59), and the event matching rule of RoutedEventHandler.
The role of the call at 0x00535d00 for command object 0x0133bd38, and of the selector gates at 0x006f5654, 0x006f5677 and 0x006f568e.
The meaning of the number argument of the subscription calls beyond the event priority byte.
